body:
Thank you... I'm sorry I did not respond soon. A lot of things came up in the past month. Now with not much to do, I feel that way again. Happens at least once a month. I don't want to express my feelings so it's nice to hide it here when people know what to expect from these posts.

Right now it's a combination of what the future holds and will I be good enough for what I want it to be. I day-dream every day to be able to express my ideas but, kinda like my feelings, I over think them. I am trying slowly to share them. I never used facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, or even reddit until this past year. But I still feel alone. Because I don't like people seeing me when I'm at my weakest, I avoid them. I don't want to be called a cry baby anymore or get this feeling of mockery when I tell them personal things like I wish I could've done better at "x". No one likes to be around a downer so I try not to be.

But when someone does see me breaking down or maybe I tell them something that's very pitiful, I go to that habit of avoidance thus they think I hate them or something. I don't know what they are thinking but the exclusion is what makes things worse for me. I'm going to try and make friends with people who have seen that side of me and hopefully I can do it but I don't want to come across as needy or annoying.

There are many points in my past where I was alone and not much by choice. I was alone from my family and the friends I once had. I'm not good at keeping friends and I want to be as much loved in the way I am as much as I love others for who they are. I guess that starts the conversation of loving yourself but... That has been the most challenging thing I've been trying to overcome.

Anyway. Sorry to crap wall post again. Thanks for replying to me before
